critical_findings.finding_1_live_gui_verification_proves_w: Phase 2D GUI verification of 8 mechanisms (via Serum 2.0.21 GUI tooltips and control readouts) confirms all 8 representative mechanisms write correctly: oscA.volume (75%), filter1.cutoff (1390 Hz), env1.attack (500ms), lfo1.rate (1.5 Hz exact), mod_routes amount (42%), arp.rate (1/32 tier), fx_chain delay (250ms L/R), global_master_volume (2.1 dB). This proves the underlying mapping.py write paths for these mechanisms work correctly with actual Serum 2.0.21.
critical_findings.finding_2_describe_preset_limitations: describe_preset() is a human-readable text summary tool, not a full structured readback API. It truncates LFO fractional rates to integers in display (1.5 -> 2, 7.3 -> 7) and omits FX sub-parameters beyond type+wet. These are serum-mcp introspection-tool display limitations, NOT write defects — Serum GUI confirms the actual stored values are correct.
critical_findings.finding_3_strict_promotion_conservative: Section-name prefix matching (e.g. 'oscA' startswith 'osc') is insufficient for promotion. Strict verification_equivalence_key matching requires exact field identity + no 'uncertain meaning' flags + matching raw_path pattern + matching conversion type. Result: only 133 controls promoted to AUTO_VERIFIED (those with exact verified-mechanism matches), vs 713 if loose section-based transfer were used.
critical_findings.finding_4_observation_gap_majority: 657 controls (58%) classified OBSERVATION_GAP: source code proves write mechanism exists, but either (a) field doesn't exactly match a Phase 2D sentinel, or (b) serum-mcp's own docstrings flag 'UNCERTAIN exact meaning' or 'TESTED no measurable effect'. These are not unresolved; they have proven write paths, but live verification is insufficient by strict equivalence-key audit.
critical_findings.finding_5_unresolved_classified_conserva: 282 controls remain UNRESOLVED: insufficient evidence to classify. These are not AUTO_VERIFIED, not OBSERVATION_GAP, not OUT_OF_SCOPE — they require either manual review or dedicated live testing.
critical_findings.finding_6_out_of_scope_evidence_backed: 64 controls OUT_OF_SCOPE with explicit evidence: browser (UI category/favorites/expanded, no corresponding PresetSpec field), clip (Ableton Live session state, not Serum preset scope), topmenu (transient GUI chrome, absent from all serum-mcp runtime modules). OUT_OF_SCOPE is distinct from UNRESOLVED — these are confirmed outside the preset file boundary.

phase_2_verification_methodology.layer_1_source_proven: Code inspection: spec.py field -> mapping.py write path -> schema.py raw parameter -> introspect.py reverse path exists (established in Phase 2B)
phase_2_verification_methodology.layer_2_live_execution_verified: Serum 2.0.21 runtime: serum-mcp write -> .SerumPreset file save -> Serum GUI loads preset -> actual control state confirms value was set (established in Phase 2D via computer-use screenshots/tooltips)
phase_2_verification_methodology.layer_3_live_readback_verified: GUI confirmation: tooltip/numeric display on actual Serum UI confirms the written value is reflected exactly (established for 8 mechanisms in Phase 2D)
phase_2_verification_methodology.terminal_states_definition: AUTO_VERIFIED = all three layers proven + exact verification_equivalence_key match + no uncertain-meaning flag; OBSERVATION_GAP = layers 1-2 proven but layer 3 insufficient or equivalence key mismatched; UNRESOLVED = insufficient evidence at any layer; OUT_OF_SCOPE = confirmed outside preset file scope

auto_verified_count_breakdown.note: Count assumes exact field match across mechanism slots (e.g., all oscA, oscB, oscC volume fields share identical Oscillator{i}.plainParams.kParamVolume write path per mapping.py code inspection). Manual verification of cross-slot equivalence transferred sibling controls only where code proves identical iteration/write pattern (not just section membership).

observation_gap_breakdown.category_a_mismatched_equivalence_key: SOURCE_PROVEN controls whose field does not exactly match one of the 8 Phase 2D verified mechanisms (e.g., env1.curve_points, lfo1.shape, arp.pattern, filter1.stereo — same mechanism family but structurally different representation or opaque/hand-drawn state)
observation_gap_breakdown.category_b_uncertain_meaning: SOURCE_PROVEN controls explicitly flagged by serum-mcp own docstrings as UNCERTAIN exact meaning, no measurable effect, or only 1 sample observed (e.g., voice_amp, voice_priority, note_latch, oversampling, porta_scaled, s1_compatibility, various ARP/voice conditions)

unresolved_breakdown.reason: Could not auto-classify from serum_atlas.py canonical_ids to PresetSpec fields or recognized mechanisms. Examples: arp.global.bank (resource browser, not kParam), voice.voicing.porta_curve (derived field), keyboard.mpe_enabled (schema hints but not exposed in PresetSpec). Requires manual review or dedicated live verification.
